title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract: Late Charge on an Installment Left Unpaid Past Its Grace Period
content:
**Servicing Policy Manual and desk system reference — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

## Scope

This policy figures the late charge assessed on an installment left unpaid past its grace period: no payment, or only part of one, has reached the installment the contract's next due date shows, and no returned payment re-opened it.

For a late charge on an installment left unpaid past its grace period that no returned payment re-opened, and only for such a late charge, the charge is the unpaid installment late charge, still capped at the lower of the product's company maximum late charge and the contract's recorded state maximum late charge; a late charge on an installment re-opened by a returned payment and a late charge on an installment whose payment posted after its grace period follow the company's own schedules for those two cases, and any other late charge is the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment portion, capped at the lower of the company maximum late charge and the contract's recorded state maximum late charge, and is not figured under this policy.

## Conditions

The grace period, the status the contract must be in and the limit of one late charge per installment due date apply exactly as the company's late charge rule for this product states them; no late charge is assessed when the unpaid installment portion is less than the product's minimum unpaid amount for a late charge or on an installment an extension deferred.

| Installment the next due date shows | Under this policy |
|---|---|
| Wholly or partly unpaid, never re-opened by a return; unpaid portion at or above the minimum; not deferred | the late charge is figured under this policy, once the grace period, status and one-per-due-date conditions are met |
| Unpaid portion below the minimum | no late charge |
| Deferred by an extension | no late charge |
| Re-opened by a returned payment, or paid after its grace period | not figured under this policy |

## Booking the charge

The charge is booked with the agent-side tool `assess_unpaid_installment_late_charge_51bb28dc`. It is a hidden tool: the agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**What one call does.** It books one late charge, dated today, against the named installment due date of the contract and adds it to the fees due on the contract; the customer can see the charge and the new fees-due balance on the account.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `retail_contract_id` | the reference number of the retail installment contract the late charge is assessed on, as returned by the retail contract lookup (`find_retail_contracts`) |
| `installment_due_date` | the due date of the installment the late charge relates to, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time zone; never empty |
| `late_charge_amount` | the late charge assessed, in USD with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the late charge reference (an opaque text identifier), the contract reference, the installment due date (YYYY-MM-DD), the late charge in USD with 2 decimal places and the new fees-due balance in USD with 2 decimal places. A sentence that starts with "Late charge assessed" means the charge is on the contract.
